text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
Go, Fine Motion!
You're the
best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was the best race ever!
Please keep
running, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... It's like the cheers are raining
down on
me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You ran incredibly, Fine. I almost started
cheering
myself...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost, but I still had a lot of
fun. It was a
wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone will be talking about
today's
race for a long time to come.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: We still have time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you... I can run to the
very
ends of the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the best memories we can
until the
day we have to part!
